verdict.rationale: The only first-party evidence is a one-line overview claim that Grok Bot lets you hand real work to AI teammates on a persistent cloud computer, which implies autonomous background execution but gives no detail on how automations are set up. The multi-agent research feature runs in real time, not as a background automation, so it does not count here. Missing for 10: documented scheduling or trigger setup, recurring or unattended automation configuration, monitoring and notification of background runs, in-depth docs, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
